covariant_direction: finite source stages X_i map to larger stages X_j and form direct systems
contravariant_direction: admissible cones C_j restrict into C_i as identities and observers are added
conformance_gate: ker A subset ker B makes C(Af)=Bf well defined
crossing: direct source colimit and inverse observer limit commute only under compatible completion, restriction, and one uniform contraction
acceptance_test: Construct compatible finite-stage contractions with one uniform bound and prove their colimit induces the completed apex contraction whose restrictions recover every observer certificate.
